description: AASHTOWare Pavement ME Design is AASHTO's production pavement design software, built on the Mechanistic-Empirical Pavement Design Guide and supporting AASHTO's Mechanistic-Empirical Pavement Design Guide, Interim Edition: A Manual of Practice. It extends the prototype computational software that accompanied the guide and is meant for day-to-day pavement design. A companion Pavement ME Deflection Data Analysis and Backcalculation Tool analyses falling weight deflectometer data, backcalculates in-place layer moduli for flexible and rigid pavements and generates inputs for rehabilitation design. Coverage: generic, for US state transportation agencies and consultants. Format and access: desktop software; the former site lists version 2.6.2.1 (July 2022) and Backcalculation Tools 1.1.6 and points to a new site, with a user group and a video channel. Licence and cost: licensed AASHTOWare product. Caveats: local calibration of distress models is needed; the version history after 2022 was not read. The model can test how changed climate and traffic loading shift pavement deterioration, supporting resilience and adaptation of road assets. It relates to LTPP InfoPave in the catalogue.
